en: Sepia-toned art reproduction postcard showing a Renaissance-style painted portrait of a noblewoman identified as Dona Maria, Infante of Portugal. She wears an elaborate dark dress with puffed white sleeves, pearl jewelry and headpiece, and holds a small folded paper or letter in her hands. Below the image is a printed caption in French referencing Chantilly and the Musée Condé, noting that this is a Spanish-school portrait.
